subject: Hospitality
title: Event Apps and Engagement
description: A short lesson to help you apply Event Apps and Engagement.

hook.text: Event apps replaced printed programs, paper maps, and static agendas. 80% of major conferences now offer dedicated mobile apps.

buildup.text: Features include personalized schedules, speaker bios, interactive maps, live polling, Q&A, networking matchmaking.

discovery.text: Event apps generate behavioral data: which sessions were popular, where attendees lingered, and who connected with whom.

twist.text: App fatigue is real: attendees resist downloading yet another app for a 3-day event.

climax.text: Progressive web apps (PWAs) solve the download problem—browser-based experiences with app functionality, no App Store required.

punchline.text: Every tap tracked, every connection mapped. Event apps turned attendees into data.

quiz.question: What problem do progressive web apps (PWAs) solve for events?
options: App fatigue—they work in browsers without requiring downloads from app stores
